in_marathi.name: Kuku
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cock or Rooster
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kuku is the name of a king or a demon. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kukkuta’, meaning ‘rooster’. The story of Kuku varies across different Hindu texts. In some, Kuku is a king who rules over a kingdom of birds. In others, it is a demon who is vanquished by gods or heroes.
